extDescription: Each booster pack contains 4 random cards.

name: Speed Duel: Arena of Lost Souls Booster Box
cleanName: Speed Duel Arena of Lost Souls Booster Box
extDescription: Each booster box contains 36 packs of 4 random cards.

name: Ectoplasmic Fortification!
extDescription:
Skill activation:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Effect:
Once per turn, if you control a Zombie monster, you can place 1 counter on this card. All Zombie monsters you control gain 100 ATK and lose 100 DEF for each counter on this card. Any battle damage you take from battles involving your Zombie monster is doubled.

name: Straight to the Grave
extDescription:
Skill activation:
At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Zone and flip it over.
Effect:
All Dinosaur, Zombie, and Rock monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Call of the Haunted (Skill Card)
cleanName: Call of the Haunted Skill Card
extDescription:
Skill activation:
At the start of the Duel, place this card in your center Spell & Trap Zone. You cannot activate this Skill during your first turn of the Duel. You draw 1 less card at the beginning of the Duel.
Effect:
Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Royal Flush
extDescription:
Skill activation:
Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.
Effect:
Once per turn, if you control "Queen's Knight", you can pay 1000 LP to Normal Summon 1 "King's Knight" in addition to your Normal Summon or Set. "King's Knight" and "Jack's Knight" you control cannot attack directly the turn you use this Skill.

name: Tomb of the Pharaoh
extDescription:
Skill activation:
At the start of the Duel, place this card in your Field Zone and flip it over.
Effect:
This card's name is always treated as "Necrovalley".
All "Gravekeeper's" monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Buster Blader
extDescription: Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster your opponent controls or is in their GY.

name: Whiptail Crow
extDescription: Attacks from the skies with a whip-like tail.

name: Possessed Dark Soul
extDescription: You can Tribute this face-up card; take control of all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters your opponent currently controls.

name: Queen's Knight
extDescription: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

name: King's Knight
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control "Queen's Knight": You can Special Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your Deck.

name: Jack's Knight
extDescription: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

name: Arcana Knight Joker
extDescription:
"Queen's Knight" + "Jack's Knight" + "King's Knight"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above materials. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets this face-up card on the field (Quick-Play): You can discard the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); negate the effect.

name: Diffusion Wave-Motion
extDescription:
(This card is not treated as a "Fusion" card.)
If your opponent controls a monster: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster monster you control; this turn, it must attack all monsters your opponent controls once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack. The effects of monsters destroyed by these attacks cannot activate and are negated.

name: Magicians Unite
extDescription: If you control 2 or more Attack Position Spellcaster monsters: Target 1 of them; its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, other Spellcaster monsters you control cannot attack.

name: Mystic Horseman
extDescription: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme speed.

name: Rabid Horseman
extDescription: "Battle Ox" + "Mystic Horseman"

name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
extDescription: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"

name: Meteor B. Dragon
extDescription: "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" + "Meteor Dragon"

name: Shield & Sword
extDescription: Switch the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters currently on the field, until the end of this turn.

name: Sword of Dragon's Soul
extDescription: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 700 ATK. After damage calculation, if the equipped monster battled a Dragon monster: Destroy that monster at the end of that Battle Phase.

name: Common Charity
extDescription: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 Normal Monster from your hand, or, if you have none, send your entire hand to the GY.

name: Senju of the Thousand Hands
extDescription: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Sphere Kuriboh
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send this card from your hand to the GY; change the attacking monster to Defense Position. When you Ritual Summon, you can banish this card from your GY as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon.

name: Desert Twister
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 WIND and 1 EARTH monsters from your GY. Once per turn: you can discard 1 card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap on the field.

name: Harpie's Pet Dragon
extDescription: Gains 300 ATK/DEF for each "Harpie Lady" on the field.

name: Amazoness Spy
extDescription: You can reveal 1 other "Amazoness" monster in your hand; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Amazoness Spy" once per turn. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Amazoness" monster in your GY, except "Amazoness Spy"; return it to the hand, or shuffle it into the Deck.

name: Gravekeeper's Ambusher
extDescription: When this card is flipped face-up: You can target 1 card in your opponent's GY; place that target on the bottom of their Deck. If this card is sent from the field to the GY after being flipped face-up: You can target 1 "Necrovalley" card in your GY; add that target to your hand. This card's effects cannot be negated by the effect of "Necrovalley".

name: Veil of Darkness
extDescription: During your Draw Phase, if you draw a DARK monster(s): You can reveal any number of them; send them to the GY, then you can draw 1 more card.

name: Conscription
extDescription: Excavate the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, Special Summon it to your field. Otherwise, add that card to your opponent's hand.

name: Skull Servant
extDescription: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

name: The Snake Hair
extDescription: A monster with a head of poison snakes. One look from this monster can turn an opponent to stone.

name: Armored Zombie
extDescription: This warrior blindly swings a deadly blade with devastating force.

name: Dragon Zombie
extDescription: A dragon revived by sorcery. Its breath is highly corrosive.

name: Clown Zombie
extDescription: A clown revived by the powers of darkness. Its deadly dance has sent many monsters to their graves.

name: Magical Ghost
extDescription: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.

name: King of the Skull Servants
extDescription: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your GY x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your GY; Special Summon this card.

name: Decayed Commander
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Zombie Tiger" from your hand. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

name: Zombie Tiger
extDescription: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Decayed Commander" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK/DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Discard 1 random card from their hand. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Great Mammoth of Goldfine
extDescription: "The Snake Hair" + "Dragon Zombie"

name: Violet Crystal
extDescription:
(This card is not treated as a "Crystal" card.)
Equip only to a Zombie monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

name: Wasteland
extDescription: All Dinosaur, Zombie, and Rock monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

name: De-Spell
extDescription: Target 1 face-up Spell, or 1 Set Spell/Trap, on the field; destroy that target if it is a Spell. (If the target is Set, reveal it.)

name: Block Attack
extDescription: Target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-up Defense Position.

name: The Shallow Grave
extDescription: Each player targets 1 monster in their own GY; each player Special Summons the target from their GY in face-down Defense Position.

name: White Elephant's Gift
extDescription: Send 1 face-up non-Effect Monster you control to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou
extDescription: Send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. Negate the effects of opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with the equipped monster.

name: Twister
extDescription: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Half Shut
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it cannot be destroyed by battle this turn, also its ATK is halved until the end of this turn.

name: Michizure
extDescription: When a monster is sent from the field to your GY, even during the Damage Step: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

name: Limit Impulse
extDescription: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 2 "Soul Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). They cannot be Tributed except for a Tribute Summon.
